description: Tokens staked in a project's own contracts: Iagon (IAG), Indigo INDY staking and Minswap yield farms (LP tokens). Without `token`: the programs with TVL in ADA, stakers, 24 h / 7 d change of the staked amount and the share held by the ten largest stakers. With `token` (a unit or a ticker such as IAG, INDY): top stakers, size distribution, 7 / 30 day inflows and outflows, lock states and the daily history. Rewards are paid off chain and are not part of the figures.

limit.description: How many programs to return (1-25, default 15).

token.description: A staked unit (56-120 hex) or a ticker / name fragment from the list (IAG, INDY, MIN). Leave out to list the programs.

name: get_token_staking
title: Token staking programs
